freeze.test_policy: No model scores viewed until both test blocks complete; retry only independent intervention validity; no tuning after opening test
freeze.shadow_policy: CART discrete and FP abstain if any core ping/TCP80/TCP10050/control probe is unknown; profile must match exactly
